overall_worst.defect: When the till says 'N till updates need attention', the troubleshooting page hands the shop owner a developer procedure: open Settings → Sync log → All, copy a DEBUG 'Register command result … status=rejected errorCode=…' line before reloading, and accept that for 'Any other code' the day's closure and cash records never reach Vendure. Nothing says plainly what staff should do right now.
overall_worst.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01 ('Till updates' / 'N till updates need attention' section)
overall_worst.fix: Open the section with a three-line 'What to do at the counter' box: keep selling, print and keep the Z report or count sheet, message your developer. Move the sync-log, errorCode and reload detail into a collapsed 'For your developer' block underneath.
